answer: An identity bond that decays stops fake identities. Each agent posts a 20-credit bond for one slot, losing 5% each epoch unless refreshed by verified work, like timber sold as real planks, ferrous parts forged for real use, or pigment mixed as real dye. Forging 500 identities costs 10,000 credits, yet fakes fail verified work, so their bonds drain and earn nothing. An honest agent pays one bond, refreshes it by work, and keeps undiluted rewards.
